system.description:
Tier 4 enchantment — Any object

Choose two other enchantments of Tier 3 or lower. You may place both enchantments on the same object. This counts as a single enchantment and you can choose the order at which the enchantments take place. For example, you can place a Clearing Enchantment on a weapon with a feature first, so that it is eligible to receive a Swift Enchantment.
